sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of paltusotine during breastfeeding. Because paltusotine is 99% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. If a mother requires paltusotine, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding.
